label: Co-founded the New Women’s Association to translate feminist awakening into suffrage law
description: Collaborating with Hiratsuka in 1919–1920, Ichikawa focused organizational theory on overturning Article 5’s ban on women’s political assembly and winning the vote.
dialecticalTension: Bridges cultural-philosophical self-awakening with institutional democratic citizenship.

citations.author: Fusae Ichikawa
citations.work: New Women’s Association Manifesto & Suffrage Writings

label: Established Japanese democratic feminist citizenship later interrogated by second-wave Marxist feminism
description: Ichikawa’s lifelong struggle against political corruption and for women’s parliamentary power set the civic terrain later critiqued and expanded by Ueno.
dialecticalTension: Advances from formal political suffrage to structural critique of unpaid domestic labor.
